name.en-US: The Priest: His Dignity and Obligations
name.pt-BR: O sacerdote: sua dignidade e obrigações

description.en-US: The 1947 English selection from the Memorial of the Ecclesiastical Life, the Apostolic Preacher and the Good Confessor, translated by W. Leo Murphy, in seven parts.
description.pt-BR: A seleção inglesa de 1947 do Memorial da vida eclesiástica, do Pregador apostólico e do Bom Confessor, em sete partes.

sources.edition: The Priest: His Dignity and Obligations, translated by W. Leo Murphy, New York, P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1947. Text layer of the Bibliothèque Saint Libère PDF (liberius.net), from the Eudist Fathers series, 1946–48.
sources.description: Converted by script: running heads and page numbers removed, paragraphs rejoined, hyphenation repaired. The OCR of the PDF text layer leaves some residual errors (for example 0 for O, rn for m); the translator’s introduction and notes are kept. The translation is not aligned chapter by chapter to the French edition, so it is a separate book.
sources.tierEvidence: Copyright 1946–48 P. J. Kenedy & Sons; no renewal in the Copyright Office records 1950–2001.
